title: Reels Editor
job_location: Provincia de Buenos Aires, Provincia de Buenos Aires, Argentina
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. 4 skills: instagram, tiktok, excel, word. Likely PH eligibility signal
why_it_might_not: Confirm Philippines eligibility before applying. Salary not disclosed
position_overview: Most short-form editors are trapped in volume millschurning out 50+ generic clips a day with zero creative input, and burning out in 3 months. We expect quality over mindless output, and actually want your creative ideas. If youre an elite editor tired of being treated like a content factory, keep reading. WHAT YOULL DO Edit short-form reels and podcast clips from raw creator content and interviews, identifying scroll-stopping moments that resonate with target audiences Analyze trends in creator niches and propose fresh reel concepts tailored to each models brand and personality Ensure platform compliance (proper framing, audio, age-appropriate content) Collaborate with creative team to refine edits based on feedback and achieve viral impact REQUIREMENTS 12 years editing short-form content for Instagram/TikTok with portfolio of approved, published reels showing strong engagement and aesthetic quality Fluent in Spanish and English (can interpret creator content, understand briefs, and communicate effectively in both languages) Expert-level proficiency in CapCut experience with DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro highly valued; must work on macOS (demonstrates commitment to professional-grade workflow and quality standards) Can identify viral moments and execute polished edits (test: create 1 podcast clip from raw interview in 20 minutesedited with captions, filters, pacing) Demonstrates creative ownership and aesthetic vision (test: given raw content with no reference, create an original reel in 10 minutes that showcases personal style and connects emotionally with viewers) WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 30 days: Daily output maintained with 80%+ first-draft approval rate Edits demonstrate understanding of brand voice and platform trends Suggests 1+ format ideas per week 60 days: Editing speed improves while maintaining quality standards 85%+ first-draft approval rate Contributes 2+ trending format ideas per week 90 days: 90%+ first-draft approval rate (high proficiency across reel and podcast production) Creates 1 original format used 5+ times by team across multiple creators Demonstrates measurable creative impact on content performance WHY BELLE MUSE? A-players onlywork with elite editors who give a shit about quality Your creative ideas actually matter (we want originals, not just copies) Clear performance metricsno guessing if youre doing well Professional standard
